goal: Use EGAST best-practice readback-sensitive item categories to seed exploratory review of whether the system appears to under-require readback on operationally important message families.
reviewPrompts: For each item family, look for scenarios where the system accepts silence, a generic acknowledgement, or an incomplete reply where a readback-sensitive response would be operationally safer.
Treat any finding as a suspicion that must be cross-checked against higher-authority material before promotion.

sourceTraceability.section: Messages containing the following must be read back

notes: This is best-practice/advisory material, not a legal or regulatory oracle.
Its role is to guide exploratory review and suspicion seeding.
